label: Birthday
tagline: A year older, with a game on top.
name: Birthday!

spaces.1: The house you were born in

chance.text: The party begins. Go to {0}. Collect 200 from the bank.
There is cake waiting at {24}. Go there. If you pass {0} on the way, take 200 from the bank.
The presents are at {11}. Go there. If you pass {0} on the way, take 200 from the bank.
The balloons are gone. Go to {12} or {28}, whichever is closer. If someone owns it, pay 10 times your last throw.
Your school bus has already left. Go to the nearest transport space. If someone owns it, pay double rent.
You are late for the party. Go to the nearest transport space. If someone owns it, pay double rent.
You get a card with money inside.
You may ask the birthday guest for a favour. Keep this card. You can use it once to get out of jail.
You lose at musical chairs. Go back three spaces.
You sprayed whipped cream on the ceiling. Go to jail right away, without passing {0}.
The council wants a permit for the party. Pay 30 per house and 120 per hotel.
You pop the birthday guest's balloon. That costs you money.
The school bus waits at {5}. Go there. If you pass {0} on the way, take 200 from the bank.

chest.text: Hooray, another year older. Go to {0}. Collect 200 from the bank.
The envelope with cards is packed full.
You drop the cake and a new one costs money.
You get the deposit back on all the bottles.
A grown-up bails you out. Keep this card. You can use it once to get out of jail.
You already opened the presents. Go to jail right away, without passing {0}.
You win the board game at the party.
You find a twenty in your pocket.
It is your day. Each player gives you 10.
You get a big envelope from Grandma.
You break your aunt's vase. The new one is expensive.
You buy a present for the birthday guest.
You get your change back from the baker.
The party is over and everything needs cleaning. Pay 35 per house and 100 per hotel.
You find sweet money under the couch.
You sell your old toys at the jumble sale.

houseRules: The birthday guest may change one rule per round.
Whoever lands on Start picks a song and everyone sings the first line.
Whoever buys a street shares a memory of the birthday guest.
